pages.title: Plunder
pages.text: §lMax Level: §r III$(br2)§lApplicable Items: §r Melee Weapons$(br2)§lEffect: §r Kills guarantee rare loot (heads, music discs — 75% at level I, always at II~III, with more items at higher levels); monster equipment drops with 60%/100%/100% chance and roughly 25%/50~75%/full durability. Boss fixed drops are unaffected.$(br2)§lConflicts: §r Looting.$(br2)§lAcquisition: §r Loot chests only, as enchanted books (treasure; no enchanting table or villager trades)
